about: The share links that each version of the link format made, each with the canvas that it must open as, and the SHA-256 of what each file holds: the text of a link, and what an expected file parses to, so that a line ending cannot change it. A file here is never edited, and none is deleted: a link that has been sent cannot be recalled, so the day a reader stops opening one of these, they are the proof (ADR-0077). A new version of the format adds a folder. They were made once, by the encoder of version 1; the bytes that a compressor makes differ between builds of zlib, so a spec decodes these and never compares what the encoder makes with them.
